card.name: The word said after a quote
card.fires_on: The word "said" right after a closing quotation mark or a pronoun (he, she) in news-style quotes of scientists or experts. Also fires weakly on the ending "idine" in dalfampridine.

modes.label: Speech verb after quote
modes.description: "said" follows a quoted statement and comes before or after the speaker's name.
modes.example: "I'm probably most proud of their self-motivation,"<< said>> Howard.

modes.label: Inside dalfampridine
modes.description: The ending "idine" in the drug name dalfampridine in label text.
